doc: Spawns effects in a rectangle centered on x and y.

effectInterval.doc: If >0, the interval, in ticks, between effect spawns.

effectIntervalFrom.doc: If >0, this is the interval at 0 progress. useProgress is ignored.

useProgress.doc: If true, effectChance will be scaled by progress.

debugDraw.doc: Shows the spawn rectangles in red.

turretShading.doc: If true, turret shading is used. Don't touch this, it is set up in unit/block init()!

under.doc: If true, the layer is overridden to be under the weapon/turret itself.

weaponIndex.doc: For units, this is the index of the weapon this part gets its progress for.

recoilIndex.doc: Which recoil counter to use. < 0 to use base recoil.
